parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by modifying the linkcheck behavior to report HTTP errors instead of anchor not found errors when `linkcheck_anchors` is `True`. The changes are minimal and well-structured.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new file `reproduce.py` which is not necessary for the fix and could be considered a project convention mismatch.
The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments to explain the logic of the new HEAD and GET request handling.
